personality_one_liner: A fast, lightweight, and professional utility that bridges the gap between customer needs and local service providers in Haiti.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for readability, but compact lists to minimize scrolling. Always account for Safe Areas.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with slight elevation for sticky headers and bottom tabs to ensure performance on low-end Android.
dont's: Do not use expo-blur or heavy glassmorphism on this app, as the brief explicitly requires optimization for low-end Android.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Login, Register, and Forgot Password flows with high contrast forms.

states.error: Standard inline form errors or full-width error banner

screens.layout: Centered logo at the top. Single column form (Email/Phone, Password). Large sticky primary CTA at bottom. No heavy background images to keep loading fast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines. Do not drift into Material Design styles or heavy shadows.
BANNED COLORS STRICTLY ENFORCED: No Blues, Indigo, Violet, Purple, Orange, Terracotta. We are using Deep Emerald Green (#107C55) as the primary brand color. Info/Neutral is dark slate/grey, not blue.

LOW-END ANDROID OPTIMIZATION: Do not use expo-blur. Keep all glassmorphism settings disabled. Use solid 'surfaceSecondary' for sticky headers, bottom tabs, and floating components to ensure high performance.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all typography. Respect the maximum font weight of 500 (no Bold/ExtraBold cuts). Use size and color for hierarchy.
IMPLEMENT A STICKY CTA for the 'Create Demand' screen. Ensure the '🔔 Aktive Demand' button is anchored to the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView and Safe Area padding.
For the Haiti context, ensure all budget inputs and displays explicitly use HTG (Gourdes) and format numbers clearly.
Ensure the 'Responders' section in 'Demand Details' has a clear visual separation from the demand's own info, utilizing 'surfaceSecondary' cards to present vendors.
Every icon used must be from the 'Feather' set. Ensure all icons share a consistent 20px or 24px size and stroke weight.
Never render text directly over an image without a gradient scrim. If applying the 'home_hero_bg', ensure a top-to-bottom transparent-to-surfaceInverse gradient is overlaid so text is readable.
